payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure the accuracy of the confidence network, including the design of a confidence estimation network and the implementation of confidence-based label smoothing.

claims.text: A confidence estimation network (ConNet) is added in parallel with the original prediction branch to predict confidence levels based on hidden states of the decoder.
Confidence-based label smoothing is employed to adjust the label smoothing based on the confidence level of predictions, reducing miscalibration.
The model is optimized to use low-layer hidden states for predicting confidence, which helps in managing the complexity of the translation task.
